title: Emirates Post Rates & Charges 2026: Prices per kg | GCC 3PL
body: Emirates Post rates per kg (UAE domestic small packets). Emirates Post does not publish one flat per-kg price for small packets. The price goes by weight band, from AED 2 (0-20 g) to AED 18 (1,001-2,000 g), then +AED 4 for each extra kg, up to 10 kg, excl. VAT, at the post office (rates effective March 2026).
